name: GEVS Level 3 — bounded pickup (spatial layer 5)
description: GEVS Level 3 — bounded pickup (spatial layer 5): pickup-cup drives the full pickup loop per INTERACTABLES_SPEC.md — (1) cup.pickup goal from the recenter spawn → planner walks to the coffee table, plays the manifest pickup prompt, and on COMPLETION the cup mesh parents to the rightHand bone (bounded range enforced); (2) carry: couch.sit goal while holding → she walks ~2.5 m and sits with the cup still attached (the carry-follow error must stay bounded through locomotion AND pose change — parenting IS the tracking, no IK); (3) cup.putdown goal after a phase recenter to the table-front spawn → on completion the mesh unparents and is placed at its authored home (0.2, 0.4, 0.92) where it stays (post-release settle window measures real mesh drift). The putdown recenter (2026-08-08) isolates the release/placement evidence from the planner's long-walk flake class (multi-meter re-approach under host load can fire a capped-turn walk with a residual heading and die blocked — measured live twice); the carry phase already proves follow-through-locomotion. Evidence comes from the pickup probe (window.__ardy.pickupProbe: holding/attached/bone/cupWorld/handWorld/followErrorM/placedAt/home) sampled at 2 Hz alongside planner telemetry, plus the per-frame root probe for carry travel. Thresholds derived from the first live run (2026-08-03, see 'basis' notes); followError is ~1e-7 by construction while parented — the real signal is a failed/dropped attach, which blows past 0.02 m instantly.

assertions.basis: the pickup probe must show holding='cup' after the cup.pickup goal completes (attach happened)
max |cupWorld - (handWorld + R·offset)| over every attached sample: ~1e-7 by parenting math; 0.02 m is float-noise headroom, 0.05 m partial catches a wobbling-but-parented frame

the carry phase (couch.sit from the coffee table, ~2.5 m) must actually MOVE the root while holding — path length, not net displacement (2026-08-08: the live carry can wander via the never-settling steering-oscillation class, 21 m path at 0.28 m net, and still be real locomotion-while-holding; a stationary hold has path ~0). The follow-through-locomotion proof itself is attachErrorM, bounded over every attached sample.
percent of carry-phase probe samples still holding the cup — she must NOT drop it mid-walk/sit (a detach would also blow attachErrorM)
the putdown probe must show holding=null after the cup.putdown goal completes (release happened)
distance from the placed cup world position to the authored home (0.2, 0.4, 0.92) at release — exact placement by construction; 0.1 m headroom
max inter-sample drift of the placed cup world position over the post-release settle window — it must stay where put (real mesh drift, not a self-report)
the manifest pickup prompt ('a person picks up a cup from the table') must appear in the planner prompt log
no residual-clamp stream resets across the three goals (a single stochastic teleport, observed 1 in ~50 check-windows, recovers → partial)
stream stays live through pickup → carry → putdown
